questions.question: How do you want to go live with the Codex resume?

options.label: Deploy live now
options.description: Commit, merge worktree→main, push, restart the monitor. Codex auto-resume goes live immediately (any blocked session, any repo).

options.label: Deploy but Codex dry-run
options.description: Merge + restart, but start Codex with USAGE_LIMIT_CODEX_ENABLED on and dry-run, so it logs 'would resume' on real limits for a while before you flip it live. Claude stays live as today.

options.label: Commit to branch, don't deploy
options.description: Save the work on the worktree branch but don't merge or restart anything yet. Nothing changes in the running system.

options.label: Leave as-is for close-thread
options.description: Leave changes uncommitted in the worktree; you'll run /close-thread later to review and merge.
